title: BuddhistBench intervention
description: One publication in an intervention study, one per line in studies/<study>/interventions.jsonl. Log it when it goes live; update status when it changes (history is kept in intervention_status.jsonl).

example.description: Format example; not a real publication.

published_at.description: UTC, ISO 8601, when the content went live (Wikipedia: the revision timestamp).

venue.description: Site or project, e.g. bo.wikipedia.org, webuddhist.org.

language.description: Language code of the published content (taxonomy/languages.json).

match_urls.description: Other URLs that count as this page (mobile, translated, redirect).

archive_url.description: Snapshot taken at publication, e.g. web.archive.org.

content_summary.description: What was published, in a sentence or two.

check_text.description: A sentence from the published content; the daily check tests that it is still on the page.

index_query.description: Search query used to test whether the page is indexed.

where.description: User page, talk page, edit summary, page footer...

community_notice_url.description: Where the study was announced to the community, if applicable.

reviewed_by.description: Reviewers who approved the content as accurate.
